assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hijacking the ubiquitin-proteasome system with small bifunctional molecules or molecular glues turned protein degradation into a designable chemical modality. It changed what chemists and clinicians can do to previously undruggable targets, and it links molecular recognition design to therapy, which is the kind of control over recognition I value most.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and established PROTACs (including the first small-molecule PROTACs and the conceptual framework). Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which explains molecular glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray and others made major later contributions, so a three-person configuration necessarily leaves out important work.
assessment.maturity: Multiple degraders are in clinical trials and the mechanism is confirmed by many independent groups; recognition is timely, though clinical approval of a PROTAC is still pending.
uncertainties: Whether the prize should centre on PROTACs or on molecular glues, and how to weigh Ciulli, Gray and Sakamoto against the chosen trio.
I cannot independently verify the current clinical status of degraders.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers reached silicon-competitive efficiencies in about a decade, a remarkable materials-chemistry success with defect tolerance, solution processing and compositional tuning as chemical themes. The impact on photovoltaics and optoelectronics research is very large.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first used perovskites as sensitizers in 2009; Park made the first solid-state, stable high-efficiency cells; Snaith showed efficient meso-superstructured and planar devices. Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis also contributed decisively, so credit is contested and a trio is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Independent replication is overwhelming and efficiencies are certified; stability and lead toxicity remain unresolved, so commercial maturity is not yet established.
uncertainties: Long-term device stability and toxicity may bear on timing.
Allocation of credit among Miyasaka, Park, Snaith, Grätzel and Seok is contentious.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling delivery technology for siRNA and mRNA medicines, including the COVID-19 vaccines. This is a clear case of molecular and colloidal design yielding a platform that changed what clinicians can deliver.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues developed the ionizable-lipid and rapid-mixing formulation principles and the early siRNA LNP work. Langer, Anderson and others also contributed lipid and materials discovery. I am unsure of the exact allocation between formulation science and lipid synthesis, and the 2023 Medicine prize already recognised nucleoside modification.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale and independently confirmed; recognition is arguably overdue.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Physiology or Medicine prize may weigh against it in Chemistry.
Attribution between lipid chemistry and process/formulation is unresolved and I cannot verify patent and priority histories.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors apply deliberate chemistry (deaminases fused to a programmable nickase) to rewrite single nucleotides without double-strand breaks. They are a powerful and rapidly adopted tool with therapeutic promise, and a clear chemical biology invention.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the concept, with Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor, requiring evolved TadA) as the decisive first authors. Nishida and Kondo independently reported a related cytidine deaminase fusion, which complicates priority.
assessment.maturity: Independently reproduced widely and entering the clinic, but the long-term clinical record is short, so the timing is somewhat early.
uncertainties: Whether the Chemistry committee would prefer to reward base editing before the 2020 CRISPR prize has settled further, and whether prime editing should be combined.
Treatment of the Nishida and Kondo priority claim.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing, built on reversible-terminator and pyrosequencing chemistry and single-molecule or clonal amplification, made genome-scale readout routine and transformed biology and medicine. It is a case where chemistry created a technology that changed what researchers can do.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded Solexa chemistry; Rothberg led 454 pyrosequencing. Mayer, Ju and others contributed key ideas, so credit among chemistry, engineering and instrument development is complex.
assessment.maturity: Technology is firmly established and universally used, so recognition is long overdue rather than premature.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as chemistry or as engineering and biology.
Priority across competing methods is uncertain to me.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Expanding the genetic code with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs lets chemists install designed amino acids in living cells, with broad applications from protein engineering and imaging to therapeutics. It gives precise control over molecular recognition and function.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the approach in E. coli and then in eukaryotes, with Wang as the first author of the early work; Chin extended it to multiple codons and to genome-recoded organisms. Mehl and Yokoyama contributed additional systems.
assessment.maturity: Widely confirmed and used in many labs; some applications (therapeutic proteins) are already commercial.
uncertainties: Allocation among Schultz, Chin and Wang is uncertain.
Some of the impact may be seen as method development rather than a single discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat showed that mutant KRAS(G12C) can be targeted covalently by exploiting its cysteine, overturning the view that KRAS was undruggable, and developed analog-sensitive kinase chemical genetics. This is a molecular design principle that reached patients.
assessment.attribution: The attribution is clean: a single laureate is credible. Other groups, including industrial teams, developed clinical drugs, but the foundational chemistry is Shokat's.
assessment.maturity: Approved KRAS G12C inhibitors confirm the concept, so the timing is good.
uncertainties: Whether the committee wishes to reward a single investigator for a compound discovery combining chemical genetics and covalent drugging.
I cannot verify the detailed priority relative to industrial work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Phase separation as an organizing principle of cells has reshaped cell biology and brought physical chemistry to it. It is conceptually influential and generates measurable, testable predictions.
assessment.attribution: Hyman and Brangwynne described P granules as liquid-like droplets; Rosen showed multivalent interactions drive phase separation. Pappu and Mittag made substantial theoretical and biophysical contributions, so a trio omits important people.
assessment.maturity: The field is still evolving, with debate over physiological relevance and the extent of condensate function, so this may be premature.
uncertainties: Debate over whether condensates are functionally relevant versus artefacts of overexpression.
Whether the work is chemistry or cell biology and which people to include.
